coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 5 ground-truth variable items: zero-shot CS evaluation, the FuseLLM versus Llama-2 comparison, and the Common Sense benchmark. The fixed task set and aggregate metric do not match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses six tasks instead of the required fixed five and computes a six-task macro-average rather than Avg.5 Tasks. It also introduces additional model controls and statistical significance requirements not specified in the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: No conclusion was provided, so there is no semantic match to the ground-truth result.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits FuseLLM's superiority across all five tasks, the 1.25% relative improvement over Llama-2, and the ARC-challenge and OpenBookQA improvements of 2.40% and 2.71%, respectively.
